mechanism_narrative: A sustained 60-day decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline over the 60-day horizon, or 20d forward returns in easing periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 4.5% triggers labor market strengthening, reducing wage growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4.5% in the next month, or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (quarterly GDP) and HOUST (monthly units) signal robust demand growth, amplifying corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise over their 5-year averages in the next month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not rise over their 5-year averages, or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 20-day period with FEDFUNDS below 5% indicates monetary easing, lowering borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains below 5% for the next 20 trading days
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% during the 20-day horizon, or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 60-day rise in INDPRO (supply index) reflects robust production capacity, reducing supply-side inflation pressures and fostering investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise over the 60-day horizon, or 20d returns in supply expansion periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A weekly HOUST crossing above 1400 units signals heightened demand for goods, stimulating corporate investment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1400 in the next week
failure_condition: HOUST does not cross above 1400 in the next week, or 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly rises in UNRATE and PAYEMS (employment) indicate labor market strengthening, reducing unemployment concerns and boosting consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both rise over their 5-year averages in the next month
failure_condition: Either UNRATE or PAYEMS does not rise over their 5-year averages, or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained INDPRO above 105 signals robust supply conditions, easing production bottlenecks and fostering market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not remain above 105 over the 60-day horizon, or 20d returns in late-cycle periods are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
